title: Agents, Benchmarks, and Embedded Play
intro: This week the AI world doubled down on agentic tricks while the hardware crowd kept tinkering with tiny silicon. From recovering lost checkpoints to running X servers on ESP32, engineers got busy on both fronts.

themes.headline: Agentic LLMs go on‑device
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** The push to shrink and specialize agents is heating up. Agentic‑OPD recovers discarded checkpoints, EngineAgent adds hardware‑aware indexing, BotPsy ships a sub‑billion‑parameter assistant, and CapLite hardens small models against prompt injection. Together they show a trend toward lightweight, on‑device agency.

items.title: Agentic-OPD: Recovering Forgotten Agent Capabilities via On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Tasks
EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities
BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts

themes.headline: New benchmarks for multi‑agent workflows
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** Researchers are finally measuring how well LLM teams juggle complex tasks. WorkflowArena tests 145 long‑horizon tasks across eight domains, while a world‑model audit shows five LLMs passing 134 of 135 scenarios. NCode’s universal AutoML also frames search as a multi‑agent problem, underscoring a broader focus on systematic evaluation.

items.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning

themes.headline: Embedded hacking hits nostalgia and new OSes
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** The embedded scene mixed retro flair with fresh OS launches. An X Window server now runs on ESP32‑S3, a desktop OS targets the ESP32‑P4’s dual RISC‑V cores, and an FPGA recreation revives the 1985 AT&T UNIX PC. Meanwhile, Buildroot celebrated 25 years, reminding us that long‑term tooling still matters.

items.title: X Window System on the ESP32
A Desktop OS for the ESP32-P4

themes.headline: Open‑source tooling for AI pipelines
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** A wave of repos is making AI pipelines more plug‑and‑play. LoopForge orchestrates coding agents, LibreTranslate offers offline translation, ggml provides a CPU‑focused tensor library, and browser‑use adds stealth browser agents. The ecosystem is maturing into ready‑to‑run components.
